summary: Lets Metro abandon about 1,177 feet of old six-inch water pipe and accept about 11 feet of new six-inch, about 170 feet of new eight-inch and about 1,003 feet of new 12-inch water pipe. The work is for three properties at 1401 Church Street, 15th Avenue North (unnumbered) and Grundy Street (unnumbered), known as CCB Phase 1A.
